title: perf: CI guard jobs clone the whole 38,800-file tree to do seconds of work
problem: Most guard workflows (Conflict markers, Checklist coverage, Prompts, Doc references, README live links, Duplicate symbols, Research, Sibling links, Link contrast) run a full actions/checkout of the tree and then a check that takes a few seconds. Checkout is now the largest single cost in the runner pool, and the account's concurrent-job ceiling makes every wasted minute a minute another PR waits.
evidence: ci_profile.py, 600 runs 2026-10-24 00:09-01:29 UTC: checkout 302 of 750 job-minutes (40%), up from 21% on 2026-10-21 (docs/history/ci-perf-2026-10-21.md)
same window: 359 jobs did <15s of non-setup work with >=15s of checkout; they took 261 job-minutes (35% of the pool), 210 of them in checkout
per workflow (jobs, job-min, of which checkout): Conflict markers 61/46.8/34.4, Checklist coverage 49/32.8/28.4, Prompts 38/25.5/20.8, Doc references 34/23.0/19.6, README live links 33/21.2/18.2
change: For each guard, list the paths its script actually reads, then use actions/checkout's sparse-checkout (with sparse-checkout-cone-mode) or a filter:blob:none clone limited to those paths. Guards that must scan the whole tree (conflict markers) keep a full tree but can use filter: blob:none plus a sparse pattern excluding binary assets, or read `git ls-files` + `git grep` on a blob-less clone. Verify each guard still fails on a seeded violation after the change. Track it with ci_profile.py's checkout share.
metric: checkout share of job-minutes in ci_profile.py --runs 600

history.note: Part 1: sparse checkouts for conflict markers, checklist coverage, duplicate symbols and link contrast; conflict-marker script fails on a missing text file. Part 2 (doc refs, README live links, sibling links) listed in docs/history/ci-perf-2026-10-30-guard-checkouts.md.

Part 2b: README live links sparse checkout; sibling links left whole (build.mjs import graph too wide, see history doc). Doc refs shipped in PR #11700. Item complete apart from measuring the checkout share.
